Right often a child gains enough maturity to walk and talk, he/she is taught different attiquetes by the family and later on, admitted to kindergarden at the age of 4-5 years. For example, in different occassions, the group of social service providers visit on make plans for any orphanage, or old age home and spend the day treating them and accompanying them. There are many groups in educational institutions like scouts, BNCC etc. who often social service and these groups are made with ideal and disciplined students. These are the true students, practicing social works in real life and setting good examples of the importance of education for humanity. The significance of social service is beyond explicable. The true sense of humanity takes birth through helping others and volunteering allows us with the sense of humanity and urgency of standing by the deprived one. It doesnt only give us the opportunity to contribute for the society and the nation but also gives us the exposure to be a better person.
